plugins.name: textbook-to-note
plugins.description: Turn your own PDF/EPUB textbooks into page-cited markdown (0 LLM tokens) and extract figures through a deterministic QC gate. Skills: textbook-to-md, figure-remap. The plugin ships the skills only: needs Python 3.10+ and `pip install -r requirements.txt` from a clone of the repo.
